Script.name: shopwin
Script.script: --[[ Shop window Sean Stoves, 2026-08-02 'list' in a shop, copied into a panel as rows you can click to buy from. The MUD's own list still scrolls past in the main window - this is an extra, and the extra is that the rows are buttons. The MUD's own output, which is what this reads: Num Level Price Qty Item --- ----- ------- --- ----------------------------------- 1 5 20 --- [Potion] Optical Precision 7 69 625 1 (Polished) plain tunic 19 50 600 1 a steel spear Quantity '---' means unlimited supply. Fixed width, and the Num column is the whole point: Aardwolf's 'buy' takes that number, so a row can be a button without guessing at keywords the way the hunt links have to. Qty is '---' for unlimited or a count for limited stock, and a sold-out line simply isn't listed. One press, one command. Clicking a row sends 'buy ' and nothing else - no confirm dialog, but also no chaining into wearing or wielding it. That's the same line the S&D panel draws: the client saves you typing, it doesn't play for you. Prices are not checked against your gold. The MUD already says no better than we could, and a client that greys out what it thinks you can't afford is wrong the moment you sell something. ]] aardkit = aardkit or {} aardkit.shopwin = aardkit.shopwin or {} local SH = aardkit.shopwin local U = aardkit.util.named("Shop") local CFG = U.load("shopwin", { on = true, gag = false, -- a copy by default; the MUD's own list still prints }) local ROW_H, PAD, HEAD_H = 20, 4, 18 -- declared ahead of the closures below so they bind these locals and not -- globals of the same name, which are nil forever local panel, rows, head, items, top items, rows, top = {}, {}, 1 panel = aardkit.panel.new({ name = "shop", title = "Shop", width = 520, height = 420, x = "200px", y = "120px", fontSize = 10, consoleless = true, transient = true, onresize = function() if aardkit.shopwin.paint then aardkit.shopwin.paint() end end, onbuild = function() rows, head = {}, nil if aardkit.shopwin.paint then aardkit.shopwin.paint() end end, }) SH.panel = panel local COL = { row = "#141b2d", hover = "#274060", text = "#c8d0dc", dim = "#8a93a8", lvl = "#3ad07a", border = "#3a4a6b", accent = "#e94560", } --- -- capture --- -- Aardwolf paints item names, and the colour carries meaning - the bonus-loot -- bracket tier, and shop items that are quest or clan gear. Read it off the -- line rather than deciding for ourselves what an item should look like. local function colour_of(text) if not text or text == "" then return COL.text end if not pcall(selectString, text, 1) then return COL.text end local ok, r, g, b = pcall(getFgColor) if not ok or not r then return COL.text end return string.format("#%02x%02x%02x", r, g, b) end -- Rows are only taken between the header and the footer. The row pattern -- matched nothing outside a shop list across every session logged, so this is -- belt and braces rather than a fix - but it's two lines, and it means the -- module can only ever react to output it has seen the start of. local listing, listing_t local function listing_off() listing = false if listing_t then pcall(killTimer, listing_t); listing_t = nil end end function SH.on_head() if not CFG.on then return end items, top = {}, 1 listing_off() listing = true -- a list with no footer would otherwise leave this armed for the session listing_t = tempTimer(10, listing_off) if CFG.gag then U.gag() end end -- " 1 5 20 --- [Potion] Optical Precision" function SH.on_row(num, lvl, price, qty, item) if not (CFG.on and listing) then return end item = U.trim(item or "") if item == "" then return end items[#items + 1] = { num = tonumber(num) or 0, lvl = tonumber(lvl) or 0, price = tonumber((tostring(price or ""):gsub(",", ""))) or 0, qty = U.trim(qty or ""), item = item, col = colour_of(item), } if CFG.gag then U.gag() end panel:show() SH.paint() end -- the MUD's own footer, and the end of the list function SH.on_foot() if not (CFG.on and listing) then return end listing_off() if CFG.gag then U.gag() end SH.paint() end --- -- paint --- local function row_label(i) if not rows[i] then rows[i] = Geyser.Label:new({ name = "aardkit_shop_row" .. i .. "_" .. (panel.gen or 1), x = 0, y = 0, width = 10, height = ROW_H - 2, }, panel.container) rows[i]:setClickCallback("aardkit.shopwin.buy", i) end return rows[i] end function SH.paint() if not panel.container then return end if not panel:visible() then return end local w = U.px(panel.container.get_width and panel.container:get_width() or panel.container.width) local h = U.px(panel.container.get_height and panel.container:get_height() or panel.container.height) if w < 80 then w = 520 end if not head then head = Geyser.Label:new({ name = "aardkit_shop_head_" .. (panel.gen or 1), x = 0, y = 0, width = 10, height = HEAD_H, }, panel.container) end head:move(PAD, PAD) head:resize(w - PAD * 2, HEAD_H) head:setStyleSheet("background-color: #0d1117; border: 0px;") head:echo(string.format(" %d for sale%s", COL.dim, #items, #items > 0 and " - click a row to buy it" or "")) head:show() local listy = PAD * 2 + HEAD_H local fits = math.max(1, math.floor((h - listy - PAD) / ROW_H)) top = math.min(math.max(1, top), math.max(1, #items - fits + 1)) local last = math.min(#items, top + fits - 1) local slot = 0 for i = top, last do local e = items[i] slot = slot + 1 local l = row_label(slot) l:move(PAD, listy + (slot - 1) * ROW_H) l:resize(w - PAD * 2, ROW_H - 2) l:setStyleSheet(string.format( "background-color: %s; border: 1px solid %s; border-radius: 3px;", COL.row, COL.border)) -- level, then the name in the colour the MUD gave it, then the price. -- Roughly 7px a character at this size; the name is what gets cut, -- because the price and level are short and always worth reading. local room = math.max(8, math.floor((w - PAD * 2) / 7) - 22) local name = e.item if #name > room then name = name:sub(1, room - 1) .. "\226\128\166" end l:echo(string.format( " %3d" .. " | " .. "%s" .. "  %s gold%s", COL.lvl, e.lvl, COL.dim, e.col, name, COL.dim, U.commas(e.price), e.qty ~= "---" and (" x" .. e.qty) or "")) l:setClickCallback("aardkit.shopwin.buy", i) l:show() end for i = slot + 1, #rows do rows[i]:hide() end end -- the row index, not the shop's number - the list scrolls function SH.buy(i) local e = items[tonumber(i) or 0] if not e then return end send("buy " .. e.num, true) end function SH.scroll(n) top = top + n SH.paint() end --- -- commands --- function SH.cmd(arg) local verb, rest = U.split_verb(arg) if verb == "toggle" then panel:toggle() elseif verb == "on" or verb == "off" then CFG.on = (verb == "on") U.save("shopwin", CFG) U.ok("Shop window " .. verb .. (CFG.on and " - 'list' is copied to the panel." or " - main window only.")) elseif verb == "gag" then CFG.gag = not CFG.gag U.save("shopwin", CFG) U.ok("Shop: " .. (CFG.gag and "panel only - the list is hidden from the main window." or "in both places.")) elseif verb == "up" then SH.scroll(-5) elseif verb == "down" then SH.scroll(5) elseif verb == "buy" then local n = tonumber(U.trim(rest)) if not n then U.warn("Usage: shop buy ") else SH.buy(n) end elseif verb == "clear" then items, top = {}, 1 SH.paint() U.ok("Shop window cleared.") elseif verb == "dock" or verb == "embed" or verb == "show" or verb == "hide" then aardkit.panel.cmd("shop " .. verb) else U.help("Shop window", { { "shopwin toggle", "show or hide the panel" }, { "state", CFG.on and "on" or "off" }, { "main window", CFG.gag and "hidden - panel only" or "still prints there too" }, { "stock", #items > 0 and (#items .. " item(s) listed") or "nothing listed yet" }, { "" }, { "shopwin", "show or hide the panel" }, { "shopwin on | off", "copy 'list' to the panel, or main window only" }, { "shopwin gag", "hide it from the main window, or show it in both" }, { "shopwin up | down", "scroll the list" }, { "shopwin buy ", "same as clicking that row" }, { "shopwin clear", "empty it" }, { "shopwin dock | embed | show | hide", "panel placement" }, { "" }, { "Type 'list' in a shop. The MUD's own list still prints in the" }, { "main window; this is a clickable copy. A row sends 'buy '" }, { "and stops there - it won't wear or wield it for you." }, }) end end aardkit.register("shopwin", "shop stock in a panel, click a row to buy it", SH.cmd)
